purpose: bring logs from every component into one place where they can be searched, correlated and kept for the right time
entry_criteria: A log platform and retention policy exist
Data protection requirements for logs are known
procedure: Use a structured format such as JSON with timestamp, level, service, version, environment and a correlation id on every line.
Ship logs from every service and infrastructure component to the central platform with the same fields.
Keep sensitive data out: no secrets, tokens or unnecessary personal data; mask what must appear.
Set retention and access by sensitivity, and keep security and audit logs longer and tamper-resistant.
Build saved searches for common questions and alerts for important error patterns.
Test that a real request can be followed across services by its correlation id.
deliverables: saved searches and a cross-service trace example
acceptance_criteria: A request is traceable across services by one id
Retention and access follow the policy
Every service ships logs with the standard fields

validation.check: send one request and search the platform by its correlation id
validation.expect: log lines from every service on the path appear

failure_modes.response: Add buffering and a delivery check

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Each service logs JSON with a request id. Searching one request id in the platform shows the gateway, order service and payment adapter lines in order, with no card data in any line.
